plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Studio Arts AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 19, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7938/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61-62; lower bound 61 used = 15+15+15+16 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 Area 2 3-4 -> 3). List A (minimum 3 courses, each from a different category): Drawing — ART 302 (requires ART 300) or ART 304 (requires ART 300); Color Theory — ART 323; Painting — ART 327 (advisory ART 300) or ART 336; Printmaking — ART 361; Sculpture — ART 372; Ceramics — ART 402; Photography — PHOTO 301. One List A course is sequenced in each of Semesters 2, 3, and 4; each slot must come from a different category. The two Cal-GETC Area 4 slots must total 6 units from 2 disciplines per the map. Advisory (ARTH 309: ENGL C1000) is a recommendation only, recorded in choice_note, never as prereq.
